clues.clue: Established in 1683, Queens was named for Catherine of Braganza, the queen consort of this English king.
clues.reveal: Charles II. Queens was named in 1683 for Catherine of Braganza, queen consort of King Charles II of England.

clues.clue: By land area, Queens holds this superlative among the five boroughs.
clues.reveal: Largest. At over 100 square miles, Queens is the largest of the five boroughs by land area.

clues.clue: A 1657 protest from CB7's Flushing demanding religious tolerance is known as this 'Remonstrance.'
clues.reveal: Flushing Remonstrance (CB7). A 1657 petition for religious freedom, seen as a forerunner of the First Amendment.

clues.clue: CB1's waterfront neighborhood is famous for its Greek community and 'Little Egypt' on Steinway Street.
clues.reveal: Astoria (CB1). Long the center of the city's Greek community, with a 'Little Egypt' along Steinway Street.

clues.clue: CB3's neighborhood is a famed 'league of nations,' with Little India, Little Colombia and more.
clues.reveal: Jackson Heights (CB3). One of the most diverse neighborhoods on earth, home to South Asian and Latin American communities.

clues.clue: CB7's downtown is one of the world's largest and fastest-growing of these ethnic enclaves.
clues.reveal: Chinatown (CB7, Flushing). Downtown Flushing is among the largest and fastest-growing Chinatowns in the world.

clues.clue: This steel globe in CB4's Flushing Meadows was built for the 1964 World's Fair.
clues.reveal: Unisphere (CB4). The giant steel globe in Flushing Meadows-Corona Park, built for the 1964 World's Fair.

clues.clue: CB4's Flushing Meadows-Corona Park hosted the World's Fair in 1939 and again in this year.
clues.reveal: 1964. Flushing Meadows-Corona Park hosted World's Fairs in both 1939 and 1964.

clues.clue: CB8's neighborhood hosted the US Open tennis tournament before it moved to Flushing Meadows.
clues.reveal: Forest Hills (CB8). The West Side Tennis Club hosted the US Open here until it moved to Flushing Meadows in 1978.

clues.clue: Queens is often called the most this in the world, with nearly 200 languages spoken.
clues.reveal: Diverse. Queens is frequently cited as the most ethnically diverse urban area in the world.

clues.clue: CB12's Jamaica is home to this international airport, one of the busiest in the country.
clues.reveal: JFK (CB12). John F. Kennedy International Airport, in Jamaica, is one of the nation's busiest airports.

clues.clue: CB14's peninsula is home to the city's only legal surfing beach, on this boardwalk-lined shore.
clues.reveal: Rockaway (CB14). The Rockaway peninsula has New York City's only legal surfing beach and one of the longest boardwalks in the country.
